scope: Read-only launch code review; no GPU work, no execution-source edits, no experiment claims.

verified.pairing: common initial parameters/head/frozen origin/RNG/g0,g1/points compared; later step trajectories are allowed to differ while realized batches remain paired
verified.gpu_policy: suite allows only physical GPUs 2–6, max_parallel=4, shared index+UUID flock leases, no-compute PID idle rule checked before/after leases, UUID CUDA visibility

verified.real_model_native_audit_gate: four native schedules versus audit_all=True on saved real Task0-entry model state/input/LR; exact submitted model/gradient/cache/buffer/mode/all-RNG state and next all-stream random draws; 33 reads / 8 isolated SGD steps; source artifacts unchanged

resolved_findings.finding: The queued real-model smoke path only runs minimal native reads. It never compares the same real CUDA model/state/batch using minimal native reads versus audit_all=True five reads before submitting SGD.
resolved_findings.evidence: four_probe_train.py calls compute(inputs,targets,closure,lr) without audit_all. smoke_pairing.py compares four native initial states and paired realized data; only test_midpoint_cpu.py invokes audit_all=True. EXPERIMENT_PLAN.md sections 6 and 8 require the native/five-read gate on the real GPU path, including submitted parameters, RNG, and next-batch identity.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Add an isolated smoke-only same-state CUDA comparison for each direction (prefer both Task0 and expanded-FC Task1), preserve native training counters/timing, verify exact U/submitted parameters/RNG/next-batch identity, and make formal launch depend on acceptance of its report.
resolved_findings.impact: The implementation looks correct and CPU equivalence evidence passes, so preflight smoke can launch. Formal training must not bypass the planned real-model minimal/full-read acceptance check.
resolved_findings.resolution: trainer/real_model_regression.py now compares all four directions from the same real Task0-entry ViT FP32 coordinates and saved augmented current-training batch: native 3/3/3/4 reads versus five-read audit, exact U/common gradients/probe points/submitted named parameters/grads/full State/RNG and next draws for every RNG stream, one natural SGD each, final anchor restoration. The existing two-task smoke pairing checks actual realized data. Gate accounting is 33 ordinary gradients and 8 isolated SGD updates, excluded from formal training. Runtime acceptance is mandatory before full diagnosis and thereby all formal training.

runtime_evidence_status: The real GPU model gate and all 24 historical diagnostic combinations executed and were queue accepted. All four formal jobs have actual first natural SGD updates, matching first actual batch identity, common g0/g1 and phi0/phi1/phi2/phim fingerprints, and startup acceptance status passed. Complete ten-task training and final results remain running.
